description: Use this when the person explicitly asks to change the name, article number, GTIN, UFI, description or search words of one of their products. Changes master data of a product of the connected account: name, article number, GTIN, UFI, description, search words. Only the fields given change; an empty string clears a field. On a public product the change is visible at once, as after "Speichern" in the dashboard, and the previous values are not kept. Visibility, category, documents and deletion stay in the dashboard. Do not use to change visibility, category or documents, or to delete a product; that is done in the dashboard.

description.description: Two or three sentences on what the product is for

keywords.description: Search words, comma separated: old names, colours, pack sizes

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

product_id.description: Product id, as list_my_products returns it

name: update_product
title: Change product master data
